lines.text: In Jehoiakim's fourth year, the LORD told Jeremiah to write his words on a scroll, and Baruch son of Neriah wrote them.
In the ninth month of the fifth year, Baruch read the scroll to all the people from Gemariah's chamber by the New Gate.
Micaiah reported the words to the officials, who heard Baruch read and told him that he and Jeremiah must flee.
Jehudi read the scroll to the king in his winter quarters, and Jehoiakim burned it in a firepot despite Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah.
After the king burned it, the LORD said Jehoiakim would have no one to sit on Pharaoh's throne.
